label: Objective probability law: determination, law fork and realization at the will step
summary: Delivers the #2145 Probability-law slice (issue comment 2026-11-27 09:06) in TruthCore.Explanation.ObjectiveProbability, stacked on #2144's shared BinaryLaw module. Formalized: unique_invariant_of_transitive (one orbit fixes the uniform law; two orbits on Bool x Bool leave the orbit mass free, a continuum of invariant full-support laws); stationary_binary_iff (stationary iff x(a+b)=b in real masses; unique for a+b>0 with an explicit stationary law, every law for a+b=0; identity, reset and flip controls; uniqueness is not convergence: the flip orbit of a point mass alternates and never reaches the unique stationary law); mixture_preserves_invariance, binary_mixture_injective and the bind_const collapse; law_fork as a general value fork on PSRStrength.Arena (constant across accessible worlds, hence not contingent, or varying and explained), applied symmetrically: if the operating law is a selector's adopted law and varies, both the law fact and the adoption fact need admitted reasons; matched controls (same record and credence, different law; admitted base reason does not fix the law); realization_independent_of_support on #462's varying profile versus the same profile with causal edges removed (a structural independence control, not a countermodel to an actual intrinsically productive disposition); a STIT model in which seeing to a law's adoption sees to neither its sample nor the contrary. Removed from the earlier draft: RealizationRoute (returned its own hypothesis with the existing necessaryRootAncestor: a projection, effectively a transcription), ProductiveControl (replaced by the slice's varying/emptied control), FixedBy/RepresentsLaw/operative (replaced by TracksValue/FixesValue). Deferred: general finite-kernel existence and irreducible uniqueness, infinite chains, topological convergence, the 1/12-grid arithmetic diagnostic (superseded by the general binary theorems); fixed ranking and no universal net selection are reused from PSRLaterAxes.probability, not re-proved. Provisional comparison: a necessary intrinsic law passes the contingent-fact PSR's constant branch, and structure can fix it uniquely, so the open questions are applicability and productive realization; a contingent brute law conflicts with the contingent-fact PSR (not logically inconsistent apart from it); a higher-order mixture helps only if its upper law is warranted and operative; personal selection can settle content for reasons without necessitating effects but faces the same demand for any contingent adoption. No demonstrated defeat of the impersonal account and no premise discharged. Lean build, binding and Comparator/NanoDa pass locally; independent semantic review pending.
blocker: Open interfaces: productive calibration of a law to the actual same root; warrant for the contingent-fact PSR's coverage of the law fact; explanation of the particular outcome beyond comparative probabilities; positive actual rational apprehension and exercise (#2145 beede613/4be0f774, same witness 29818edd/66aecdd7). Next test: a premise identifying the admitted reason for a contingent law or content fact at the root with intentional exercise, assessed against a necessary intrinsic law with a structurally unique form.
